full_page.content:
Mrs. Grace Brady 149 Jordan Avenue San Francisco, California
August 26. God bless you Grace; - you and yours -
these days of God's merciful grace and patience. notwithstanding our lamentable want of apprecia- tion and gratitude How wonderful the works of the Lord! How inexplicable His ways and His mercies above them all! How fortunate for us! Be indulgent to K.
